'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Aaron Groth LS Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Groth]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Tacos & Burritos
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
